# A44 — Supplementary Online Material index

Supplementary Online Material carries no word limit under IJL Stylesheet 2024 §1.1
(unlike appendices, which count against the 4,000–8,000 band), so the reproducibility
apparatus ships here rather than inline.

Each file is supplied with author-identifying paths and remote URLs removed for
double-blind review; the live repository URLs are restored at camera-ready.

| Supplement | Contents | Source path |
|---|---|---|
| **S1** | Tier-A candidate lists per dictionary (engine output) | `detectors/combined_candidates.txt` |
| **S2** | Headword spine used by the toolset | `sanhw1.txt` |
| **S3** | External-source attribution for headwords | `detectors/get_external_source.py` |
| **S4** | Declared-language settlement | `detectors/triage_lang.py` |
| **S5** | SLP1 utilities, incl. load_whitelist() | `detectors/slp1util.py` |
| **S6** | Generator for the do-not-file suppress list | `detectors/gen_do_not_file_suppress.py` |
| **S7** | Do-not-file suppress list (2,297 deduped headwords) | `nochange/do_not_file_suppress.txt` |
| **S8** | Evaluation harness (false-positive gate) | `detectors/eval.py` |
| **S9** | Held-out gold correction set | `detectors/gold_corrections.tsv` |
| **S10** | Body-aware triage workflow | `detectors/bodyaware_workflow.js` |
| **S11** | Triage scripts (detectors/triage_*.py) | `detectors/` |
| **S12** | Operational triage procedure per dictionary | `.claude/commands/dict-triage.md` |
| **S13** | Per-dictionary triage working directories | `corrections_draft/` |
| **S14** | Triage overview across 33 dictionaries | `corrections_draft/README.md` |
| **S15** | Entry-decidable error classes with evidence lines | `corrections_draft/SHS/readme.md` |
| **S16** | Per-row source re-verification narrative | `corrections_draft/VERIFICATION_2026_07.md` |
| **S17** | Per-row re-verification record | `corrections_draft/file_first_verified.tsv` |
| **S18** | Inter-rater reliability inputs and outputs | `corrections_draft/irr/` |
| **S19** | IRR input builder | `detectors/irr_build_inputs.py` |
| **S20** | IRR agreement (exact rational arithmetic) | `detectors/irr_agreement.py` |
| **S21** | Computed agreement statistics | `corrections_draft/irr/agreement_stats.md` |
| **S22** | Cross-family IRR re-run | `detectors/irr_cross_family.py` |

**Note on S1.** `detectors/combined_candidates.txt` is generated and git-ignored, so it
is not in the repository: it must be regenerated before packaging. This is a genuine
reproducibility gap the anonymisation pass surfaced, not an artefact of anonymising.
